purpose: Draft finite-slice ledger for D8a of the diversity program (#290): one primitive cross-type composition witness plus a short census. D8b (novel outcome) and D8c (measured advantage) are not claimed.

entries.claim: With provisional type kind(w)=net(w), composition by concatenation, and admissibility requiring both constituents open and the composite ZFA-closed, the pair a='^', b='v' is an admissible cross-type composition: kind(a)!=kind(b) and a+b='^v' is ZFA-closed. The short census finds 112 admissible cross-type compositions and 0 same-type at depth 2.
entries.formal_scope: Finite twist words of length 1-2 over the 8-twist alphabet; provisional oriented net-action type; concatenation-only composition. This is not a Penrose/golden-ratio claim, not a novel-outcome theorem (D8b), and not a measured diversity advantage (D8c).
entries.comparator: Exhaustive short census in diversity_composition.py and data/diversity_d8a_census.json.
entries.kill_condition: A witness that is not cross-type under the declared type, a composite that is not ZFA-closed, or any D8b/D8c/diversity-advantage conclusion inferred from D8a alone.
